annotations.title: Find clothes that match a description

description: Wardrobe Connect. Find clothes that match a short description of one item, such as "black pleated wide-leg trousers" or "cream cable-knit jumper". Takes only the item description and, if wanted, a size, a price limit, the condition and a country; it needs nothing else from the conversation. Returns eBay listings in the Clothing, Shoes and Accessories category, closest matches first and then cheapest first, plus search links for other shops and a Facebook Marketplace search phrase. Listings must match the colour, fabric and kind of garment named, and men's or women's if given; kids' items only when asked for. Adult, fetish and costume listings are never shown, repeat listings of the same item count once, and listings far below the typical price for the search (usually bait or junk) are left out.

condition.description: Condition: new, used (pre-owned) or any. Default any. pre-owned and second-hand are read as used.

country.description: Two-letter country code for the eBay site and currency. Defaults to where the request comes from.

max_price.description: Most to pay, in the local currency, shipping included.

q.description: Just the item, in a few words: colour, type, fabric or style, and brand if known, for example "navy midi wrap dress". Up to 100 characters, with no other conversation text or personal details.

size.description: The size to match, for example M, XL, 12, UK 9, US 8.5, EU 39 or W32. Dress and shoe sizes are converted between UK, US and EU.
